nodes.label: docker-socket-proxy service
nodes.rationale: tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy filters only path+method, not the request body — POST+CONTAINERS is root-equivalent by itself. The effective boundary is network isolation (docker-proxy-net, internal:true), not the API-group flags.

nodes.label: provisioning-agent service
nodes.rationale: mem_limit set after finding an unbounded nixpacks build (1-2GB) could push the kernel OOM-killer to pick PostgreSQL by oom_score, taking the DB of every tenant offline.

nodes.label: P0-1: Docker socket proxy network isolation
nodes.rationale: Before: docker-socket-proxy was reachable from every customer container with no auth — POST /containers/create with a root bind mount and privileged:true gave root on the host. Fix: moved the proxy off traefik-net into an internal-only docker-proxy-net that only the agent joins.
